title: The Cost and Network Limits of Space-Based AI Compute
research_focus: Roofline analysis, Performance modeling, Collective communication, Datacenter networking, Network topology, Distributed training

problem_statement.en: Sparse torus cuts can restrict gradient synchronization despite plentiful accelerator compute.
problem_statement.zh: 即使 accelerator compute 充足，稀疏 torus 的 cut capacity 仍會限制 gradient synchronization。

key_innovation.en: An analytical comparison connects network bisection bandwidth and workload bisection intensity through a roofline model.
key_innovation.zh: 分析比較將 network bisection bandwidth 與 workload bisection intensity 連結至 roofline model。

baselines_compared: Terrestrial Clos with 800 Gbps links and 2:1 oversubscription; orbital 2D/3D torus configurations.

key_improvements.en: Table 3 assigns 28800 TB/s bisection bandwidth to Clos, 2.25 TB/s to orbital 2D torus, and 10 TB/s to orbital 3D torus at 100 Gbps per ISL.
key_improvements.zh: Table3 在每條 ISL 為 100 Gbps 下，指定 Clos 為 28800 TB/s bisection bandwidth、orbital 2D torus 為 2.25 TB/s、orbital 3D torus 為 10 TB/s。

source.scope_en: The model assumes a particular global data-parallel traffic mapping and theoretical torus links. Application cut traffic, feasible optical wrap-around links, terminal count, topology alternatives and measured training steps determine transferability.
source.scope_zh: 模型假設特定 global data-parallel traffic mapping 與理論 torus link；application cut traffic、可行 optical wrap-around link、terminal count、替代 topology，以及實測 training step 決定結果的適用範圍。
